title: Mistakes in recitation: spotting and correcting kindly: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 2 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Mistakes in recitation rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 2. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Clear mistakes in Al-Fatihah
points: ص said as س in ٱلصِّرَٰطَ

panels.title: Correcting with adab
points: Wait for the end of the ayah
Name the ayah, word and fix
Thank the person who corrects you

head: Not this
This
rows: Interrupting mid-word and listing every slip
Wait, then give one precise correction, starting with any lahn jali

keywords.def: a mistake in recitation: jali (clear) or khafi (hidden)
a clear mistake: letter or vowel changed
a hidden mistake: a rule not fully applied

questions.q: Classify: (a) short muttasil in 36:6 ءَابَآؤُهُمْ; (b) ح said as ه in ٱلْحَكِيمِ (36:2).
questions.a: (a) lahn khafi (rule not fully applied); (b) lahn jali (letter changed).

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite Ya-Sin 36:1 to 12 (or read it from the mushaf if not yet memorised); your partner records any lahn jali and khafi on the pupil PDF. Today's rota group recites to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner sheet with mistakes classified and one correction given kindly.

questions.q: Extend: write your own three most common lahn and how you will fix them.
Stretch: explain why a mistake of the tongue is forgiven but practice is still required.
questions.a: Two rewards for the one who struggles (Bukhari and Muslim), yet we strive to recite as revealed.

options: Lahn jali: it changes the meaning
questions.a: A) Lahn jali: it changes the meaning. A changed vowel that changes 'You favoured' into 'I favoured' is a clear mistake.

questions.q: Think again: If someone corrects your recitation in front of others, how do you want them to do it?
questions.a: Gently, precisely and privately where possible; this is how we correct others too.
